quickref.name: Tutorial
quickref.era: BBR single-player training mode, in the game by Jul 21, 2012 (wiki screenshot date) [Fan-wiki file data]. Wiki page created Oct 25, 2012. Carried into BBG at launch (May–Jun 2013) [Fan-wiki]. 2013–14 tweaks: HUD briefing removed, signs moved, SW Boots recharge 7 s then 2.5 s, Pro-Mode Jump added, out-of-bounds exploits patched [Fan-wiki]. No documentation after 2014 except the 2026 material
quickref.in_2026: Playable in the first 2026 playtest build 2.54.0: fan video 'BBG Tutorial Speedrun (1:20)' by JustNubz, Jul 9, 2026 (thumbnails Observed; the upload itself is unverified fan content). SkyVu soundtrack track 18 'Tutorial' 0:32 [Canon]. Not mentioned on the Steam store or in any 2026 Steam news post. Probably not one of the '16 wacky maps' [Inference]. Launch-build status unconfirmed
quickref.setting: A 'virtual' training course [Fan-wiki]: an endless black void full of vertical green code-glyph rain, Matrix-like [Observed; homage is Inference], with a dark grid floor, neon arrow walkways and floating circuit-panel blocks. The goal is a hologram of the Pelican't drop ship [Observed; Fan-wiki]. Linear, enclosed by invisible barriers, single-player, offline, no damage [Fan-wiki]
quickref.palette_and_lighting: All light is emissive neon, with no sky, sun or time of day [Observed]. Void #000200. Floor #001700 with grid up to #082A0C. Rain #043909 to #1B6A22. Walkways #20C813 to #41FA2C (2026: #4FFF22 to #5AFF39). Floating panels #06FB02. Pelican't hologram #19FD0A / #00FD00. Amber signs #392600 to #483500 with yellow rims and text #EAE955 to #F9FA6F. Targets #EFFB31 and orange #E17221 to #FF9141. Lasers #E0050D to #E73910. Jump-pad cyan #88F4E4 [Observed samples]
quickref.landmarks: Hologram Pelican't inside concentric green rings (the goal). Green digital-rain void. Amber instruction panels on bent neon posts with floating 3D labels (MOVING / MOVE, SHOOTING, PICKUPS, OPTIONS) and yellow leader lines. Neon chevron walkways at several heights, plus floating circuit blocks. Finish-line row of cyan jump pads with yellow dashed rims. PICKUPS row of glowing-framed panels. Red and orange lattice bear dummies [Observed]
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No damage (0% intake). Laser walls gate progress until the targets are shot. Moving targets and Huggable-face targets. A Bearscream Sandwich in the centre that never respawns. Jump pads. Historic exploits: endless fall out of bounds, a laser-wall launch, and a vault off the end of the jump pads [Fan-wiki]. A secret achievement 'Hey, stop trying to break our game!' was claimed and later removed from the wiki [Unverified]. Matchmaking lines quote The Matrix [Game text via wiki]. 'CONSECTETUR' (Lorem ipsum) appears in the code rain [Observed, partial]. Tutorial A Salt Rifle has 70 rounds and pre-v1.0 stats [Fan-wiki]. Mode card shows a baby Huggable with a toy spaceship [Observed]

corrections.current_text: It is the only class that can access the Tutorial, with Turkish SW Boots. Corroborated by the Steam copy naming the A Salt Rifle, Bearzooka and Turkish SW Boots.
corrections.correction: It is the only class that can access the Tutorial, using the Oliver skin, A Salt Rifle (70-round tutorial version), Bearzooka, B.E.A.R. Club, Turkish SW Boots and Pro-Mode Jump [Fan-wiki]. The 2026 Steam copy names the same three items but does not mention the Tutorial, so the link is our inference, not corroboration.
corrections.evidence: The Steam appdetails for app 4408320, fetched 2026-10-16, contain no 'tutorial' text in the short description, the detailed description or About the Game. The loadout list is from the wiki Tutorial page wikitext, fetched via the MediaWiki API.

corrections.current_text: [FAN-WIKI] The wiki lists 15 BBG maps across the original run, and Haunted Castle and Desert Airmine were removed at 2.0 and Haunted Castle later returned
corrections.correction: Clarify: the wiki's BBG Maps page lists 15 arenas, while its 'BBG Maps' category has 16 members because it also includes the single-player Tutorial. Do not count the Tutorial toward Steam's '16 wacky maps'. The 2026 soundtrack lists 16 map-named tracks and a separate 'Tutorial' track among the menu tracks.
corrections.evidence: BBG Maps page wikitext (15 links, no Tutorial). The category list in scratchpad/maps/bbg_map_titles.json includes 'Tutorial'. Steam soundtrack app 5321720 track list: tracks 1–16 are maps, 17 'Main Menu (BBG)', 18 'Tutorial' 0:32.

corrections.current_text: - **Context:** the wiki's version table stops at 2.25 [Fan-wiki]. "2.54.0" is probably the late legacy client, matching "no new features" in July, and 3.0.x is the re-release branch [Inference].
corrections.correction: Only the 'Battle Bears Gold/Versions' page stops at 2.25. The wiki's Updates page continues the BBG table: 2.25.2, 2.26–2.31, 2.50–2.53.3 (Aug 31, 2018), 3.0 (Nov 15, 2021, incl. 'New Map Lighting') and 3.0.1 (Dec 18, 2021). '2.54.0' (also shown on the Jul 9, 2026 tutorial speedrun thumbnails) therefore continues the 2.53.x line. 3.0 was a 2021 mobile update, which weakens the claim that 3.0.x is the re-release branch. The same fix applies to line 448 ('The wiki's version table stops at 2.25.').
corrections.evidence: Wiki Updates page wikitext (BBG section, version list ending 2.53.3, 3.0, 3.0.1 with dates) and the Battle Bears Gold/Versions page (ends at 2.25), both fetched via the MediaWiki API on 2026-10-16. Thumbnails https://i.ytimg.com/vi/-RSuAlfOUow/maxresdefault.jpg and sd3.jpg show '2.54.0'.

open_questions: Did the Tutorial ship in BBR 1.0 (Oct 8, 2011)? The earliest dated evidence is a wiki screenshot from Jul 21, 2012.
Does SkyVu frame the Tutorial in-universe anywhere, for example as a simulation aboard the Pelican't? No official text was found, and web.archive.org was unreachable.
Is the Tutorial in the Nov 4, 2026 launch build? Is it counted among Steam's '16 wacky maps'?
Did the secret achievement 'Hey, stop trying to break our game!' exist (claimed on the wiki in 2013, then removed)?

What is the order of the stations (MOVE, SHOOTING, MELEE/WEAPON SWITCH, TEAM COLORS, PICKUPS, USE SPECIAL ITEM, OPTIONS, jump pads), and where exactly are the laser walls? This needs gameplay footage.
Did BBG 3.0 'New Map Lighting' (Nov 2021) or the 2026 'Lighting improvements' change the Tutorial's look?
Which composer wrote the 0:32 'Tutorial' soundtrack track?
Which video is the source of the wiki's 'TEAM COLORS' thumbnail (File:Mqdefault_(6).jpg)? Are the dummies red and blue by team?
Is the 'CONSECTETUR' reading in the code rain correct, and are the other columns Lorem-ipsum words too?
